rationale: The discussion has clarified the economic test and narrowed the dispute to comparable-value treatment, but the core conflict remains unresolved: the union/trust rejects being treated as ordinary unsecured claims, while bondholders reject any trust preference and co-funders demand domestic protections that management and the task force see as constraining viability. Positions are now well-defined and stable, so further open debate is unlikely to resolve the impasse without a mediating intervention.
